checklist.why: Recorded-condition job; names Status, Banner, TaskChips instead
Both lists present with library alternatives
Tag and detail parts named; day and note optional
Tag on walk/profile/health-record, Detail on the finding page
Care levels drawn; interaction states none, with reasons
Each care level has its own icon and an announced care word
Name and care caps, ellipsis demo, zh example
Text semantics, aria-hidden icon, row aria-label
Component CSS is all tokens and lists its variables
Preview and variants render at 375px, no overflow, no clipped names

variants.name: Tag
findings: Monitor and Treat in place are the same amber; on screen they differ only by a 12px icon (the care word is visually hidden)
Inspection recolours the tag per screen for a pending feed (.pending-feed-tag .st-condition)
'No feed' is coded care attention/monitor, though it is a standing instruction (notice)

variants.name: Detail
findings: Header says Fever, detail says Treat in place · Day 2: nothing repeated

findings.text: The migration left an unclosed comment at ux/system/inspection-astra-concept.css:684 ('/* Care state belongs to its finding{width:...'), which swallows every rule up to line 728. Dead: attention-row care tints (monitor and treatment now identical rgb 252,244,229), the pen-feed stopped state, and the log filter controls (pig-profile.log: category trigger 20px, date trigger 40px tall, below the 48px floor).
findings.fix: Restore '/* Care state belongs to its finding, rather than a second duplicate badge. */' on its own line and put the attention-row rules back on the lines after it.

findings.text: Monitor and Treat in place share amber; on the pig list the care level shows only as a 12px eye vs syringe icon.
findings.fix: Keep amber for both but show the care word visibly for Treat and Hospital, or give Treat its own token if the farm needs it at a glance.

findings.text: The profile and health-record 'attention-row' is a hand-built look-alike with its own care colours (care-treatment orange #924514): a second care map.
findings.fix: Build it as a Row whose icon slot is the ConditionTag mark (st-condition-mark with data-care/level); delete the .attention-row.care-* tints.

findings.text: Per-screen recolouring of a pending feed tag breaks 'never choose a colour per screen'.
findings.fix: Draw the pending look inside the component (notice with a struck name), or drop the override.

findings.text: 'No feed' is passed as attention/monitor with careText '0.0 kg/day'.
findings.fix: Pass care:'notice'; use amber only if it needs action, and say so in the care word.

proposals.name: attention-row into Row + ConditionTag mark
proposals.why: Same job (a condition with its care level) with its own colour map
